description:
Five dystopian flavored tracks inspired by the works of Harlan Ellison and other sci-fi giants! 

Bobby brings the paranoia-fueled prose over Messiah Musik soundscapes for a harrowing journey into the future and beyond.
credits:
Lyrics by Bobby Noble
Beats by Messiah Musik
Mixed by Rapswell
Mastered by SQ
Artwork by Nick Arcade
